answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 21577 Country: India Title: Please tel me, is it sunnah for girls to cover their heads while eating, drinking and sleeping. Also i know that we have to wear burka outside but what is the sunnah length of shirt for girls? Till the shin and without slits? Please tel me. Also is it sunnah to cover the head with cloth all the time for girls? Question: Please tel me, is it sunnah for girls to cover their heads while eating, drinking and sleeping. Also i know that we have to wear burka outside but what is the sunnah length of shirt for girls? Till the shin and without slits? Please tel me. Also is it sunnah to cover the head with cloth all the time for girls? Answer ID: 21577 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 763/668/L=1431) (1) If there is no non-mahram in the house, then the girls can keep their head open while eating, drinking water and sleeping, however it is better to cover one's head while eating. (2) The length of girl's qamis (kurta) should be below knees so that it covers the satr well. (3) It is allowable for girls to keep their head open in front of their mahram; however it should not be made habit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
